title: Jurisdiction coverage updates envelope
description: Validates only jurisdiction.coverage_updates inside a legacy jurisdiction artifact. Other artifact fields are intentionally not validated by this schema.

jurisdiction.description: Legacy jurisdiction artifact envelope. Only coverage_updates is constrained here.

coverage_updates.description: One evidence-backed coverage disposition for each discovered rules[] or conflicts[] entry. Schema validation does not prove the runtime rule set, source equality, or referenced-entry existence.

ruleId.description: The exact identifier read from rules[] or conflicts[]; it is never invented or normalized.

evidenceRef.description: A compact reference to an existing, evidence-bearing entry in this same jurisdiction artifact; it is not duplicate legal evidence.

collection.description: Existing artifact collection containing the referenced evidence-bearing entry.

id.description: Exact existing entry id in the named collection.

coverageUpdate.description: A coverage work-state only. covered means an evidence-backed rule disposition was completed, never that the contract is legally safe.

section.description: The root rules.yaml array that supplied rule_id.

check_source.description: Exact runtime <read_and_pinned rules_path>#<section>/<rule_id>. The Skill verifies cross-field equality.

status.description: Existing five-state matrix work status. Unknown, locked, unassessed, or unresolved work remains blank.

reason.description: Concise evidence or non-disposition reason. It does not create a legal finding.

evidence_refs.description: References to existing evidence-bearing artifact entries. blank may be empty only for an explicit locked, unknown, unassessed, or pending reason.
